title: Open a taxable brokerage with tax-efficient holdings
summary: Once tax-advantaged space is exhausted, the taxable account is the unlimited next bucket. Hold tax-efficient assets here.
detailsHtml:
Asset location strategy

Different assets generate different types of taxable income. Optimizing where you hold which asset can add 0.2–0.5% per year in after-tax returns — meaningful over decades.

  • Taxable account: Broad-market equity index funds and ETFs. They generate mostly long-term capital gains and qualified dividends, taxed at preferential rates (0–20% plus 3.8% NIIT for higher earners). Municipal bonds also belong here if you're in a high bracket.
  • Tax-deferred (Traditional 401(k), Traditional IRA): Bonds and other ordinary-income generators. Their interest would otherwise be taxed at marginal rates of up to 37%; shielding them is high-value.
  • Roth (Roth IRA, Roth 401(k)): Highest-expected-growth assets — small-cap, emerging markets, growth equities. Tax-free growth is most valuable on the assets that grow the most.
